title: Endpoint Assistant
brief: Place the empty receiver flask in a visible centering cradle and mark a teacher-configured endpoint-observation-ready state; no titrant delivery is simulated.

migration.legacyLearningObjective: Program receiver positioning and endpoint-observation readiness while distinguishing configured cues from physical titration measurements.
migration.redesignRationale: Dropwise titrant delivery and endpoint measurement imply unsupported fluid, force, and measurement fidelity. The robot role is redesigned to position the receiver and mark a visibly identified configured observation-ready state.
